summary: Three message-marks compatibility tests read which features their previous-release member advertises, so they hold against v0.3.25 and against v0.3.26, which already records and answers for marks. Tests only.

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or schema version change.

compatibility.detail: No product change. Against a baseline without message_view_reads (v0.3.25) the tests assert what they did before; against one with it (v0.3.26) they assert that the release records its seats' steps as marks and answers reads of them, and that a member rolled back to it keeps marks on.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs before the daemon serves.

recovery.detail: No product change; rolling back is unaffected.
